description: Validates an operator-supplied Mississippi Business Reports XLS/XLSX export projection without acquiring data or asserting statewide completeness.
redirect_policy: No HTTP requests or redirects are permitted.
retry: No automatic retry; the operator must explicitly replace or correct the local package.
checkpoint: Read-only validation returns an in-memory local-review projection; no release, admission, or pointer is written.
idempotency: Workbook SHA-256, ordered derived JSONL SHA-256, selection SHA-256, and transformation version identify an inspection.
cancellation: Abort cooperatively before and during row validation; no output artifact exists to clean up.
retention_profile: Operator inputs and person-free projections remain local pending source-specific rights review.
